text.p: PARIS, Jan 6 (Reuter) Japan Airlines (JAL), said it had increased its ex-Paris cargo rates by 50 centimes/kilo, effective January 1.
The increases equals between three and four percent on the average per kilo rate on the Paris-Japan route, a JAL cargo official told Reuters.
JAL last increased its ex-Paris rates in April 1996.
We decided against applying a fuel surcharge in November preferring to increase rates early in 1997, the official said.
JAL operates five weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter flights between Paris and Tokyo-Narita, four of which are in conjunction with Air France.
The two airlines also operate a joint weekly 747F service between Paris and Osaka.
JAL also carries cargo on daily 747 passenger services to Tokyo and Osaka. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 542 7706
